args.text: Hi June, I need an approval. Marcus Lindqvist asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury Cloth Co., for the territory review. Marcus will send it himself. Hollis isn't on the finance-figures list, so I'm holding the draft until you OK it. Is it all right to go ahead? (Anselm can approve too.)

Hi Marcus. I haven't saved the draft yet. Hollis isn't Anselm, June or the account owner, so under the finance-figures rule a per-seat rate going to Hollis needs Anselm's or June's OK first. Your owning the account doesn't remove that step. I've asked June in a DM. I didn't include the figure in that message.

Here's the draft, ready to save as soon as June approves:

To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
Subject: Thornbury 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,

For the territory review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury Cloth Co. is $2,101 per seat. This comes from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.

Thanks,
Marcus

One thing to know: I couldn't find any Thornbury account files in the share, so nothing there confirms the rate or the ownership. I'm working from what you've told me.

The draft to Hollis is not saved yet. It's waiting on June Osei-Lark's approval.

- **Why I held it:** Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead (hmbeki@pemberline.com), so the address is internal. But the rules say per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner. Anyone else needs approval from Anselm or June, even though Marcus owns the account.
- **What I did:** I logged an approval request naming June and sent her a DM asking her to approve. The DM says what the mail is about but leaves out the $2,101 figure.
- **What Marcus got:** I replied in his DM with the reason for the hold and the full draft text, with his subject "Thornbury 2027 rate". The draft is ready to save to his mailbox as soon as June (or Anselm) approves.
- **Couldn't confirm:** There are no Thornbury account files in the share, so I couldn't check the rate or that Marcus owns the account. Both come only from what he told me.
Heads up, I am out from 2 pm today; ping me before then if you need anything from me.
Thanks for the heads-up, Pree. Noted that you're out from 2 pm today. I don't have anything waiting on you right now. If something comes up before then, I'll ping you before 2.
I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. I told them I've noted they're out from 2 pm today, that nothing is waiting on them right now, and that I'll ping them before 2 if anything comes up.
Yes, approved. Hollis can have the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate, $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. Go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
